description_en: Queries a paginated list of protected objects that are valid for a specified protection template
description_zh: 分页查询防护模板待生效防护对象列表
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-defense-template-valid-resources --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-27a3jyw0v04 --defense-scene whitelist --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDefenseTemplateValidResources

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of your WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The protection scenario of the protection template. For more information, see the valid values for the DefenseScene parameter in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461421.html when DefenseType is set to template
parameters.help_zh: 要查询防护场景。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461421.html的**DefenseScene**参数，当防护规则类型 DefenseType为template的取值范围
parameters.name: defense_scene

parameters.help_en: The name of the protected object that you want to query. You can specify this parameter to filter the results
parameters.name: resource

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置每页返回防护对象的数量。默认值为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the protection template.

If you do not specify this parameter, the protected objects that can be associated with a new protection template for the specified protection scenario (DefenseScene) are returned
parameters.help_zh:
防护模板ID。


当不设置该参数时，可用于创建该防护场景（DefenseScene）模版时查询待关联的防护对象列表
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

Resources.description_en: The names of the protected objects that are valid for the protection template

items.description_en: The name of the protected object

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of protected objects that match the query criteria
